senses.gloss: पश्च- + अनुताप पश्च- + अनुताप (cf. पश्चात्), m. repentance.
पशु- + चर्या पशु- + चर्या, f. acting like beasts, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 23.
पश्चात्- + ताप पश्चात्- + ताप, m. repentance.
पाश- + धर पाश- + धर, m. (holding a noose), a name of Varuṇa, Hariv. 4808.
पशु- + धर्म पशु- + धर्म, m. 1. manner of treating cattle, Pañc. 34, 16. 2. a custom fit only for beasts, Man. 9, 66.
पशु- + पति पशु- + पति, m. a name of Śiva.

पश् पश्, i. 10 पाशय, Par. To bind. पाशित, Bound, Hariv. 3536.
 --With the prep. अव अव, ptcple. of the pf. pass. अवपाशित, Bound, Rām. 3, 59, 18; cf. दृश्, and स्पश्.
 --Cf. probably Goth. fahan; A.S. fón with feng; O.H.G. fahan with fang, fôgjan; [] A.S. fegan; Goth. fahjan; O.H.G. gafagjan; A.S. ge-fegan; Lat. pac in paciscor, dispesco for dis-pec + sco, compesco.

† पष् पष्, i. 1, Par. Ātm., v. r. of स्पश्, q. cf. i. 10, पषय, Par.
 1. To bind.
 2. To hinder.
 3. To touch.
 4. To go (v. r. पश्).
 --i. 10, पाषय, Par. To bind (v. r.).
† पस् पस्, i. 1, Par. Ātm. v. r. of स्पश्, q. cf. i. 10, Par. पासय, To bind (v. r.)

पशव्य पशव्य, i. e. पश्व् + य, adj.
 1. Fit for cattle.
 2. Brutish, Bhāg. P. 8, 5, 42, with काम, sexual intercourse.

पशु पश् + उ, m.
 1. Cattle (viz. neatcattle, horses, goats, sheep, asses, and dogs), Man. 10, 48.
 2. A beast, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 304.
 3. An animal to be immolated, Rām. 1, 61, 8.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Goth. faihu; A.S. feoh; Lat. pecus, pecoris and pecudis; probably also πῶϋ.

पशुता पशु + ता, f.
 1. The condition of cattle, Man. 3, 104.
 2. The condition of an animal destined to be immolated.

पशुत्व पशु + त्व, n.
 1. Bestiality, Prab. 59, 11.
 2. The condition of an animal destined to be immolated.

पशुमन्त् पशु + मन्त्, adj., f. मती,
 1. Abounding in cattle, MBh. 2, 798.
 2. Possessing many flocks, 4, 1162.
पशुमारक पशु-मार + क, adj. Accompanied by immolation of animals, Bhāg. P. 4, 27, 11.
पशु-मार + क पशु-मार + क, adj. accompanied by sacrificing beasts, Bhāg. P. 4, 27, 11.
पशुसमाम्नायिक पशुसमाम्नायिक, i. e. पशु-समाम्नाय + इक, adj. Read of in the books on animal sacrifices, Utt. Rāmac. 114, 3.

पश्चात् पश्चात्, abl. sing. of the ved. adj. पश्च, i. e. अपस् (= अप)-अञ्च् + अ (cf. तिरश्चीन),
 I. adv.
 1. [] Behind, Man. 2, 196.
 2. From behind, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1235.
 3. After, afterwards, Man. 8, 164.
 4. Backwards, Yājñ. 2, 299.
 5. Westward, Megh. 16.
 II. prep. with gen. and abl. After, Man. 3, 116.
 --Cf. probably Lat. postid-ea, post; akin is also pone for pos-ne, perhaps ὀπίσσω.
पश्चात्तापिन् पश्चात्तापिन्, i. e. पश्चात्-ताप + इन्, adj. Repenting, Yājñ. 3, 221.
पश्चार्ध पश्चार्ध, i. e. पश्च (cf. पश्चात्) -अर्ध, m. Hind-part, Śāk. d. 7.

पश्चिम पश्चिम, i. e. पश्च (cf. पश्चात्) + इम, adj., f. मा.
 1. Hinder, last; with संध्या, The evening twilight, Man. 2, 101; with क्रिया, Obsequies.
 2. Western, west, Man. 2, 22.
 --Comp.
पश्चिमतस् पश्चिम + तस्, adv. From behind, MBh. 4, 2108.
पशु- + पाल पशु- + पाल, m. 1. a herdsman. 2. pl. the name of a people.

पाश पाश, i. e. पश् + अ, m.
 1. A tie, a string, a chain, a fetter, MBh. 1, 6749.
 2. A string for fastening tamed animals.
 3. A net or noose for catching birds, Hit. 21, 10.
 4. A noose as principal attribute of Varuṇa, Rām. 3, 54, 9 (cf. the Vedas).
 --Comp.
पशु- + पाश पशु- + पाश, m. the fetter which enchains the soul, i. e. the external world, Prab. 59, 7.
पाशन पाशन, i. e. पश् + अन (m. or n.), A noose, MBh. 7, 5923.
पाशभृत् पाश-भृ + त्, m. (holding a noose), Varuṇa, Ragh. 2, 9.

पाशव पाशव, i. e. पशु + अ, adj.
 1. Come from animals, animal, Nal. 23, 10.
 2. Used by animals, beastly, Lass. 11, 11.
पाशवन्त् पाश + वन्त्, adj. Possessed of a noose, MBh. 7, 3136.

पाशिन् पाशिन्, i. e. पाश + इन्,
 I. adj. Having a noose, MBh. 8, 1998.
 II. m.
 1. Varuṇa.
 2. A proper name.

पाशुपत पाशुपत, i. e. पशु-पति + अ,
 I. adj., f. ती, Belonging or referring to Śiva.
 II. m. A follower or worshipper of Śiva in one of his forms as the supreme deity of the Hindu triad, Rājat. 5, 403.
पाशुपाल्य पाशुपाल्य, i. e. पशु-पाल + य, n. The business of a grazier rearing and keeping cattle, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 20.

पाश्चात्त्य पाश्चात्त्य, i. e. पश्चात् + त्य, [] adj.
 1. Last, posterior, Pañc. ed. orn. 49, 15.
 2. Western, Ragh. 4, 62.

पाषण्ड पाषण्ड,
 I. m. n. Heresy, Man. 5, 90.
 II. adj. Heretical, MBh. 12, 11284.
 III. m. A heretic, Prab. 21, 1.
पाषण्डिन् पाषण्डिन्, i. e. पाषण्ड + इन्, m. A heretic, Man. 4, 30.

पाषाण पाषाण, m. A stone, Yājñ. 2, 298.
 --Comp.
पशु- + बन्ध पशु- + बन्ध, m. immolation of an animal, MBh. 3, 184.
पाश- + बन्ध पाश- + बन्ध, m. a net or noose, Hit. i. d. 44.
पाश- + बन्धक पाश- + बन्धक, m. a birdcatcher, Pañc. iii. d. 224.

पाश- + बन्धन पाश- + बन्धन,
 I. n. a snare, Bhāg. P. 9, 16, 31.
 II. adj. caught in a snare, Kathās. 13, 105.
पशु- + भर्तृ पशु- + भर्तृ, m. epithet of Śiva, MBh. 13, 620.
पशु- + मार पशु- + मार, m. the manner of killing a beast, MBh. 3, 370.
पश्चान्मारुत पश्चान्मारुत, i. e. पश्चात्-, m. wind blowing from behind, Ragh. 7, 51.
पशु- + रक्षिन् पशु- + रक्षिन्, m. a herdsman, Man. 8, 238.
पाश- + रज्जु पाश- + रज्जु, f. fetter, Kathās. 18, 298.
पशु- + समाम्नाय पशु- + समाम्नाय, m. works on animal sacrifices, Utt. Rāmac. 114, 6.
पाश- + हस्त पाश- + हस्त, adj. bearing a noose in his hand, Rām. 3, 54, 9.
